business_summary: TerraSky Co.,Ltd. provides cloud products and solutions in Japan and internationally. The company offers cloud integration services comprising Salesforce, AI agent implementation support, MuleSoft Anypoint, Amazon Web services, Heroku, contact center, SAP migration, B2B commerce, and financial services cloud and marketing cloud solutions, as well as solutions for manufacturing industries. It also provides cloud consulting services comprising digital marketing support, DX promotion consulting, AppExchange consulting, marketing tool implementation support service, production support solutions, and data utilization support service; development support tools, such as mitoco X, flosum, ACCELQ, DCSpider, skyvisual editor, and Elements.cloud services; and cloud services, including mitoco ERP, mitoco, Mitoco accounting, mitoco Work, mitoco AI, Fujitsu GLOVIA OM, Soask for subscription management, CloudSign for Salesforce, Salesforce Field Service, Insurance Agency Solution for insurance agents, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud, OMLINE-I, OMLINE-O, ChoiceRESERVE Reservation Integration, SVF Cloud for Salesforce, MotionBoard Cloud for Salesforce, and invoiceAgent for to digitizing paper documents. The company was formerly known as Head Solutions Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Terasakai Co.,Ltd. in February 2007. TerraSky Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
